sloka: पावकस्य सुतः श्रीमान् नीलः अग्नि सदृश प्रभः ।तेजसा यशसा वीर्यात् अत्यरिच्यत वीर्यवान् ॥१-१७-१३॥
transliteration: pāvakasya sutaḥ śrīmān nīlaḥ agni sadṛśa prabhaḥ ।tejasā yaśasā vīryāt atyaricyata vīryavān ॥1-17-13॥

translations.english: Aswini devatas, endowed with wealth and beauty, procreated Mainda and Dwivida who were highly esteemed for their beauty.
